required_evidence: The generated graph and its source-scope digest determine one reproducible sequence.
Select the old mixed plan, omit a backend producer, or reclassify a chart renderer as backend: reject.
A relevant source, policy or scope amendment invalidates affected receipts and BG-001 without erasing historical evidence.
Every changed implementation group and historical feature has a source-to-backend-to-screen-to-test chain.
Delete a PR-only action, discard a complete candidate branch without dispositions, or report an inferred effect as observed: reject.
Cherry-pick or port bounded accepted changes onto the canonical implementation lineage only after F15 and source admission; keep rollback to exact source.
A pending fill with a rejected venue stop triggers the same admitted recovery as an immediate fill and updates risk and Attention.
Inject rejected/unknown protection at delayed or partial fill; a local rule alone must not yield CONFIRMED or permit additional risk.
Keep protective orders and reservation state through crash; reconcile original receipt/position before any compensating action, with no blind close retry.
At-touch and gapped quote fixtures preserve the limit in both directions; explicit capped-market fixtures preserve their separate slippage envelope.
The current 1.10000 limit with 0.00010 spread and 0.00002 slippage must never fill a BUY at 1.10007 or a SELL at 1.09993.
After a gap, respect limit/stop/stop-limit distinctions; missed fills are not fabricated to preserve historical backtest counts.
A four-hour STOP_ENTRY cannot remain eligible for 24 hours; PRE_BLACKOUT/POST_BLACKOUT moves eligible pending orders into cancellation workflow.
Drop max_wait, substitute a later expiry, or fill an ineligible resting order without reconciliation/Attention: fail.
Model cancel/fill and partial-fill races honestly. Reserve full remaining risk until authoritative cancellation/expiry/readback; reconcile a fill that wins the race.
EXPIRED, CANCELLED and REJECTED unfilled orders disappear from working-order totals but remain in historical records; partial positions retain actual exposure.
A stale ACCEPTED receipt after terminal readback must not resurrect Working; duplicate fill/cancel events must not double-count.
Snapshot replay produces the same positions, orders, reservations and summaries after restart.
FX, JPY, metals and alternative broker digit fixtures produce correct bounds from actual contract metadata and remain within the approved loss envelope.
Unknown digits, stale contract revision, a rounded stop beyond risk or below broker distance, or treating an old absolute cap as a new fraction: refuse.
Quote or contract changes invalidate the preview; historical mandate/template versions replay with their original units.
New-row work scales with appended records while honest replay matches full verification in SQLite and Postgres.
Tamper, truncate, fork, roll back, replace a ledger or supply a stale checkpoint: fail closed and force full verification. The research always-True monkeypatch is forbidden.
Checkpoints are rebuilt or verified after restart; concurrency and interrupted checkpoint writes cannot leave risk operating on untrusted state.
Restart replays the same locks; independent manual/autonomous cooldown tests coexist with shared all-origin hard-limit tests.
A restart resets losses, a default silently changes a signed policy, a manual entry bypasses total-account drawdown, or an owner reset erases economic loss: reject.
A signed reset changes a permission state or risk reference with an audit event, never the immutable economic performance history; unknown policy/collateral blocks new risk.
Known-profit/loss fixtures match analytically specified results and the actual execution adapters' admitted semantics.
Disabling controls, altering quote units or a permissive fill model without a distinct experiment identity invalidates promotion evidence.
An evaluator correction invalidates dependent candidate conclusions and schedules reproducible reevaluation; old results remain labeled historical.
Replay of each named chronological fold yields the same pre-cutoff decisions and verified split provenance.
Future-only perturbation changes past decisions, a scaler sees the holdout, or window count is only the count of calendar years: fail.
Tainted fold/candidate artifacts cannot be reused as independent promotion evidence; retain audit lineage.
From permitted raw inputs, a second run reproduces the same bars, sessions, costs and outcomes.
Bid is silently treated as midpoint, fixed EST becomes DST-local time, a bar is used before close or a mirror is unpinned: reject qualifying use.
Keep lawful metadata and reproducibility scripts without republishing restricted data; qualifying tests await admitted data while unrelated authorized engineering continues.
Each reported metric identifies the population, formula/version, trial set, uncertainty and selection scope.
A pooled PBO is relabeled pair-specific, losers disappear from trial count, or repeated holdout tuning is called independent: fail promotion.
A no-qualified-candidate result is valid; do not search until a cherry-picked pass can be manufactured.
A weekly run is idempotent by period/strategy/dataset/evaluator; results reproduce and a candidate reaches only permitted next states.
A model edits protected execution/risk paths, repeated runs duplicate studies, a failed candidate becomes a promotion opportunity, or an unsigned candidate trades live: refuse.
Resume interrupted jobs from durable checkpoints; outdated evaluations are invalidated, not overwritten; current production champion remains unchanged.
A pre-signed ticket arms only in its declared readiness envelope and can claim the nonce once.
Empty proof, arbitrary real proof label, proof for another account/event, re-signed weakened allowlist or concurrent duplicate use: reject.
Arming and consuming a grant are not a broker fill; unknown submission follows the order reconciler, never a second order.
Deposit/withdrawal/credit/fee and pending-order interleavings reconcile exact money, positions and risk without false P&L.
Redirect settles money, a timeout resubmits, deleting restores secrets, unclassified flow silently improves risk capital, or a withdrawal bypasses concurrent reservations: reject.
Rollback never erases financial events; credential cancellation returns RELINK_REQUIRED and broker closure remains independently verified.
Every mapped owner action and new capability has one traceable caller and appropriate screen/sheet/dialog outcome.
A visually complete screen lacks its source or any backend is unfinished; BG-001 and frontend entry refuse.
A newly discovered missing backend capability reopens its backend unit and invalidates affected BG/UX proof before front-end compensation.
Every one of the 90 forecast requirements maps to an active unit and test; all required child backend receipts reach BG-001.
A child F15/BG independently opens UI, Qlib or Freqtrade sends a live order, or a unavailable provider is labeled healthy: reject.
Data/model failure yields explicit abstention or unavailable state; no economically qualified model is a permissible result, not permission to omit software.
The complete pack rebuilds identically and invalid evidence cannot change readiness.
Edit input and matching local hash, delete a receipt, swap source revision, self-declare signature_valid, or reuse device evidence across builds: block readiness.
Record revoked/stale evidence; regenerate affected planning fingerprints and rerun relevant tests without erasing old records.
Full-scope native dark/light goldens, action reachability and physical S24 cases match the same backend catalogue revision.
Only showcase flows pass, legacy UI leaks into new modules, safety states are hidden for aesthetics, or unknown data looks live: reject final qualification.
Reduce motion/material cost gracefully without removing semantics; preserve signed identity and reversible cutover until every required feature is verified.

required_evidence: Registered service evidence changes a later eligible choice and a valid candidate reaches authorized test binding.
Remove outcome subscription: integration fails; an always-fallback or always-reject stub cannot qualify.
Restart replays learned state, current binding and outstanding parent policies unchanged.
Reducer writes only evidence projection; selector emits sealed decision.
Direct, API, event and restore attempts to write EXECUTION_POLICY or mandate through learning boundary all fail.
Restore validates allowed target/scope before publishing evidence state.
Actual callback/event consumes mature outcomes into selector snapshot.
Unit-test-only observe call with no production subscriber fails integration.
Consumer crash after applying event resumes from committed cursor without double count.
Known matching/account paths agree with independent oracle.
Unqualified fill semantics used to declare profitable candidate: blocked.
Evaluator revision invalidates affected qualification without deleting original runs.
New objective uses new epoch; existing parent remains on approved old epoch.
Mid-parent mutable alias switch or mixed model/selector snapshot: fails.
Crash in epoch swap resolves one binding using durable promotion identity and readback.
Approved manual and automated spot orders complete real permitted venue lifecycle.
Read-only crypto research, importable SDK or paper-only adapter cannot claim spot execution complete.
Venue outage preserves old markets isolation and honest crypto unavailable state.
Appropriate actual permitted environment proves authenticated order/query/cancel/economic readback.
Replay/static response labeled real venue fill/settlement: gate rejects.
Unavailable required provider remains blocked with precise alternate qualification plan.
Every source section/gap and inherited ID maps to owner/contract/test.
Drop NeuralForecast plugin, funding feature or old action for lean scope: verifier fails.
Amendments preserve prior hashes and explicit owner-approved supersession.
